'''Dragoș Iliescu''' (born November 5, 1974) is a Romanian [[psychologist]] and academic. He holds the position of professor of psychology at [[University of Bucharest|Bucharest University]] in Romania and serves as an Extraordinary professor at [[Stellenbosch University]] in South Africa. Since 2017, he has been the director of the doctoral school of psychology and educational science at [[University of Bucharest|Bucharest University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Dragoș Iliescu – Assessment and Individual Differences Lab |url=https://aid-lab.ro/team/dragos-iliescu/ |access-date=2025-06-22 |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Education ==

Dragoș Iliescu was born in Brașov, Romania, where he attended the German Honterus-Kolleg until grade 8 and subsequently enrolled at the [[Grigore Moisil National College of Computer Science (Brașov)|Grigore Moisil National College of Computer Science]]. In 1997, he graduated from the [[National Intelligence Academy]] in Bucharest with a bachelor's degree in socio-psychology.<ref>{{Cite web| title=Curriculum vitae Europass - ILIESCU, Dragoş | url=https://doctorat.unibuc.ro/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Dragos-ILIESCU-CV.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201029111723/https://doctorat.unibuc.ro/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Dragos-ILIESCU-CV.pdf | archive-date=2020-10-29}}</ref> He obtained a Ph.D. in psychology from [[Babeș-Bolyai University]] in 2003, with a thesis titled "Psychosocial Aspects of Organizational Change," supervised by Professor Horia Pitariu. His areas of specialization include psychometrics, psychological and educational assessment, as well as work and organizational psychology.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Aspecte psihosociale ale schimbării organizaţionale {{!}} WorldCat.org |oclc=895766762 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Dragos Iliescu |url=https://scholar.google.ro/citations?user=TzsCQ_YAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=scholar.google.ro}}</ref>

== Service in scientific organizations ==
In Romania, Iliescu has participated in various scientific and professional organizations, holds leadership positions in two of them. He is a co-founder of the Romanian Association of [[Industrial and organizational psychology|Industrial and Organizational Psychology]] and served as a council member for two terms, from 2002 to 2010 and again from 2013 to 2020. He was the association's president from 2010 to 2013. Additionally, he has held the position of Secretary-General of the Romanian Psychological Association since 2017.

Internationally, Iliescu has held leadership positions in several scientific and professional organizations.

He has served as a council member of the [[International Test Commission]] from 2008 to 2018, during which he held the position of council member, secretary-general, and president. His tenure as president represents the highest position in a professional international association held by a Romanian. In 2018, he was recognized for his contribution to the International Test Commission and was named "Fellow of the ITC."<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.intestcom.org/page/9 |title= International Test Commission|website=www.intestcom.org |access-date=March 7, 2020}}{{title missing|date=May 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.elearning.ro/romania-prezenta-la-2016-international-test-commission-conference-vancouver-canada |title=România – Prezentă la 2016 International Test Commission Conference, Vancouver, Canada &#124; Elearning în România |website=www.elearning.ro |date=July 2016 |access-date=May 14, 2020}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=International Test Commission |url=https://www.intestcom.org/news/23 |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=www.intestcom.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Creativity4Better. Human Creativity for Societal Change. |url=https://www.creativity4better.com/speakers/dragos-iliescu/ |access-date=2025-06-22 |language=en}}</ref>

As of May 2019, Iliescu serves as the treasurer of the European Association for Work and Organization Psychology.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.eawop.org/web-editor |title=EAWOP - European Association of Work and Organizational Psychology |website=www.eawop.org |access-date=May 14, 2020}}</ref> He has been the president of Division 2 (Psychology Assessment and Evaluation) of the [[International Association of Applied Psychology]] (IAAP) since 2022, having held the position of President-Elect since 2018. Additionally, he has been the Secretary-General of the European Network for Organizational Psychology (ENOP) since 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-25 |title=ENOP Members |url=https://enop-psy.org/current-enop-members/ |access-date=2025-02-20 |website=European Network of Organizational Psychologists |language=en}}</ref>

He has served as editor-in-chief of the ''European Journal of Psychological Assessment'' from 2021 to 2024. and is currently the Editor-in-Chief of ''[[Intelligence (journal)|Intelligence]]'' (co-Editor with Samuel Greiff).<ref>{{Cite web |title=International inviteds |url=https://ciap2024.com/en/international-inviteds/ |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=CIAP - I Congresso Internacional de Avaliação Psicológica |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Entrepreneurship ==
Iliescu has founded and managed several businesses that focus on the applications of psychology in various settings. In 1999, he established D&D Research, a company specializing in market research and consumer psychology.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-11-20 |title=Educarea sistemului de educatie {{!}} Revista Biz - Prima revista de business din România |url=https://www.revistabiz.ro/educarea-sistemului-de-educatie/ |access-date=2025-06-22 |language=ro-RO}}</ref><ref>http://www.ddresearch.ro/and-the-tedx-ambassador-goes-to-dragos-iliescu/ Published February 22, 2016. Retrieved April 22, 2020</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-03-30 |title=D&D Research, 15 years later – the road from "at least 2 solutions" to "cool, old school" – AdHugger |url=https://www.adhugger.net/2015/03/30/dd-research-15-years-later-the-road-from-at-least-2-solutions-to-cool-old-school/ |access-date=2025-06-22 |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2003, he founded Testcentral Romania, which has become the primary publisher of psychological tests in Romania.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-10-22 |title=BRIO se exinde cu o investiție din partea familiei Pavăl {{!}} Revista Biz - Prima revista de business din România |url=https://www.revistabiz.ro/brio-se-exinde-cu-o-investitie-din-partea-familiei-paval/ |access-date=2025-06-22 |language=ro-RO}}</ref> In 2012, he launched 42 Organizational Assessment, a talent assessment company that serves as the SHL distributor for Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia, and the Czech Republic.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ZF Live - Dragoş Iliescu, managing director al firmei de consultanţă 42 Organizational Assessment Romania: angajaţii români sunt ultracompetitivi. Suntem la fel cum sunt şi alţii. Nu suntem mai proşti, nu suntem mai buni |url=https://www.zf.ro/zf-live/zf-live-dragos-iliescu-managing-director-firmei-consultanta-42-organizational-assessment-romania-angajatii-romani-ultracompetitivi-fel-altii-prosti-buni-10779517 |access-date=2025-06-22 |website=ZF.ro |language=ro}}</ref> In 2016, he founded Brio Romania, which has become the primary platform for educational standardized testing in Romania.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.creativity4better.com/speakers/dragos-iliescu/ |title=Creativity4Better. The Value of Bravery |website=www.creativity4better.com |access-date=May 14, 2020}}</ref>

== Research ==
Dragoș Iliescu's research focuses on individual differences, including cognitive abilities and personality. His work addresses these areas from both assessment and applied perspectives.

He was the Chair of the ITC task force that developed and published in 2023 ''The Test Adaptation Reporting Standards (TARES)''.<ref name=":0" />
